description: This Java source file defines the class TypeUtils, which provides utility methods for working with Java types, including conversions between human-readable types and descriptors, handling class names, packages, and signature normalization.

classes.name: TypeUtils
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods for Java type conversions, package/class name manipulations, and descriptor generation.

methods.name: typeToDescriptor
methods.description: Converts a human-readable Java type into its JVM descriptor form, handling primitives, arrays, and object types.

methods.name: simpleClassNameToBinary
methods.description: Converts a simple class name to its binary name by replacing dots with dollar signs.

methods.name: classNameOnly
methods.description: Extracts the class name from a fully qualified binary class name.

methods.name: packageNameOnly
methods.description: Extracts the package name from a fully qualified binary class name.

methods.name: ambiguousToBinaryName
methods.description: Normalizes a class name to its binary form, attempting to resolve package ambiguities based on an ApiList.
